title: Data Structures and Algorithms
summary: The most asked topic in coding interviews, taught in Python: Big-O, arrays, hashing, linked lists, stacks, trees, graphs, sorting, recursion, greedy and dynamic programming.
outcomes: Judge the time and space cost of code with Big-O
Choose the right structure: list, hash map, stack, queue, heap, tree or graph
Solve problems with two pointers, sliding window, prefix sums and binary search
Traverse trees and graphs with DFS and BFS, and find shortest paths
Recognise greedy and dynamic programming problems and solve them
Approach any coding interview question step by step
